newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-GASCOIGNE INJURES ANKLE IN SIX-A-SIDE TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GASCOIGNE INJURES ANKLE IN SIX-A-SIDE TOURNAMENT.

text.p: England midfielder Paul Gascoigne hurt his ankle during a six-a-side tournament in Amsterdam on Monday, Dutch ANP news agency said on Tuesday.
It was not immediately clear how serious the injury was but it came just two weeks ahead of a World Cup qualifier against Italy.
Gascoigne, who plays for Glasgow club Rangers, collided with Ajax Amsterdam goalkeeper Fred Grim during the first match in the four-team competition in the Amsterdam Arena.
ANP said Gascoigne had flown back to Britain for treatment. Rangers said he would undergo X-ray examination of his leg on Tuesday.
The two-day tournament, developed by former Barcelona coach Johan Cruyff, also features Liverpool and AC Milan.

England coach Glenn Hoddle, who is due to name his side on Thursday for the February 12 match against Italy at Wembley, learned on Monday that striker Teddy Sheringham was unlikely to be fit because of an ankle injury.
